items.source: You need to ready alchemist gems in your quiver.

Imbue an alchemist gem with an explosive charge of mana and throw it.
		The gem will explode for %0.1f %s damage.
		Each kind of gem will also provide a specific effect.
		The damage will improve with better gems and with your Spellpower.
items.target:
向一块炼金宝石内灌输爆炸能量并扔出它。
		宝石将会爆炸并造成 %0.1f 的 %s 伤害。
		每个种类的宝石都会提供一个特殊的效果。
		伤害受宝石品质和法术强度加成。

items.source:
Grants %d%% protection to you, your golem and other friendly creatures against the elemental damage of your own bombs, and against external elemental damage (fire, cold, lightning and acid) by %d%%.
		At talent level 5 it also protects against all side effects of your bombs.
items.target:
提高你和其他友好生物对自己炸弹 %d%% 的元素伤害抗性，并增加 %d%% 对外界的元素伤害抗性。
		在等级 5 时它同时会保护你免疫你的炸弹所带来的特殊效果。

items.source:
Your alchemist bombs now affect a radius of %d around them.
		Explosion damage may increase by %d%% (if the explosion is not contained) to %d%% if the area of effect is confined.
items.target:
炼金炸弹的爆炸半径现在增加 %d 码。
		增加 %d%% （地形开阔）～ %d%% （地形狭窄）爆炸伤害。

items.source: You need to ready at least two alchemist gems in your quiver.
items.target: 至少需要装备两枚炼金宝石。

items.source:
Crush together two alchemist gems, making them extremely unstable.
		You then throw them to a target area, where they explode on impact, dealing %0.2f physical damage and knocking back any creatures in the blast radius.
		Each kind of gem will also provide a specific effect.
		The damage will improve with better gems and with your Spellpower.
items.target:
将 2 颗炼金宝石压缩在一起，使它们变的极度不稳定。
		然后，你将它们扔到指定地点，爆炸会产生 %0.2f 物理伤害并击退爆炸范围内的任何怪物。
		每个种类的宝石都会提供一个特殊的效果。
		伤害受宝石品质和法术强度加成。

dependency_context.source:
When you throw your alchemist bombs, you infuse them with flames that burn for a few turns.
		In addition all fire damage you do is increased by %d%%.
		You cannot have more than one alchemist infusion sustain active at once.
dependency_context.target:
投掷炼金炸弹时，为其注入会持续灼烧数回合的火焰。
		此外，你造成的所有火焰伤害提高 %d%%。
		同一时间只能激活一种炼金充能持续技能。

claims_to_verify: Throw Bomb computeDamage selects FIREBURN only while Flame Infusion is active and returns one scalar bomb damage value with the selected damage type.
The action applies spell critical and any Explosion Expert confinement adjustment before passing the scalar value to the selected projector for each affected grid.
Self, golem and friendly protection may scale the per-grid scalar before FIREBURN, without changing its total-versus-per-turn meaning.
Scalar FIREBURN treats its input as total event damage: half immediate and the remainder through a default three-turn EFF_BURNING effect.
Throw Bomb info formats the dynamic scalar through damDesc and the dynamic localized damage-type name through DamageType:get(damtype).name.
The localized FIREBURN damage-type name is fire burn→火焰燃烧 and Flame Infusion separately states that infused bombs burn for a few turns.
Determine whether the current Chinese Throw Bomb sentence materially misstates the displayed total or is an adequate generic dynamic tooltip.
